versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Slow, pale cave olms whose units sit on countdowns (Vigils) and act when they finish.
Every finish adds Dripstone, a permanent total that the tribe's payoffs grow from; tools speed clocks up, repeat them or put them on other tribes' units.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
A Vigil now ends at most once a turn, which stops the Guild Knocker loop that gave endless goldens.
The Sitter, Netopir, Parkelj and the lake now say exactly what they do and in what order; the Olmling is 2/2 for the early fights.

stop_reason: 2 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
